**Adding rotation drag functionality**

I also need to patch a large one-line SVG string safely using Python without shell conflicts.

item.text:
Built the garden simulator in [index.html](/private/var/folders/7z/5mtgxwxx4zs9ppgzm942gbmh0000gn/T/workspace.s1O6uI/app/index.html), [src.js](/private/var/folders/7z/5mtgxwxx4zs9ppgzm942gbmh0000gn/T/workspace.s1O6uI/app/src.js), and [style.css](/private/var/folders/7z/5mtgxwxx4zs9ppgzm942gbmh0000gn/T/workspace.s1O6uI/app/style.css). It includes the animated dish, fruit-seeking and contact behaviors, live tuning controls, five presets, blob inspection, recorded population charts, and garden summaries. The browser and visible titles are both **GPT-6**.

`deno check src.js` and the manifest, title, preset, simulation, and chart checks passed. In a 600-second in-process run, the balanced preset recorded blue populations from 21 to 55 and red from 136 to 147 in the displayed history window; the 120-second preset run also showed distinct fruit-rich, low-fruit, and red-heavy outcomes.

I couldn’t verify the page in a browser on port 9106: Portly fails because its app executable is missing, direct binding to 9106 is denied in this environment, and `pnpm` exits with a macOS keychain error (139). The dev and preview scripts are configured for port 9106, but a live runtime check remains unverified.
